description: This source file contains the implementation of the AzureTableGrainDirectory class, which manages grain directory entries in an Azure Table storage for Orleans. It includes methods for lookup, registration, unregistration of grain addresses, and lifecycle management within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainDirectory and ILifecycleParticipant for managing grain directory entries using Azure Table Storage.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryEntity
classes.description: Represents a table entity for a grain directory entry with methods for conversion to and from GrainAddress objects.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up a grain address by grain ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address, optionally with a previous address for optimistic concurrency.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a specific grain address from the storage.

methods.name: UnregisterMany
methods.description: Unregisters multiple grain addresses in bulk, utilizing batching.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Placeholder method for unregistering silos, currently a no-op.

methods.name: InitializeIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures the table is initialized; called during lifecycle events.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the grain directory to lifecycle events to perform initialization.

methods.name: GrainIdToRowKey
methods.description: Encodes a GrainId into a URL-safe row key string for storage.

methods.name: RowKeyToGrainId
methods.description: Decodes a row key string back into a GrainId object.

methods.name: ToGrainAddress
methods.description: Converts a table entity to a GrainAddress instance.

methods.name: FromGrainAddress
methods.description: Creates a table entity from a GrainAddress instance.
